question: R1485 retains real PE gains, but SIMD formatting and AArch64 paths have stable sub-percent ARM native losses. Compare original dense-token and high-bit-tagged iterators against released next, and map scalar/SIMD instruction addresses to their actual owners.
method: One ARM64 host, frozen mixed-ISA consumer, three exact-source executables, fixed guest path/inode/size/ASLR, identical corpus and checksum comparisons, exclusive Callgrind Ir/Dr/Dw attribution.
qualification: Instruction counts do not measure hardware timing. Do not replace native results or qualify publication from this diagnostic alone.
